# Wealth Bridge Tax & Business Consultants

> Independent tax and business consulting firm in Tamil Nadu, India, established in 2007, with offices in Vellore (Katpadi) and Chennai (Vadapalani). Main work: income tax and GST return filing; replies to notices, personal hearings and appeals under income tax, GST, the Companies Act and PF & ESI laws; central and Tamil Nadu government subsidies; detailed project reports and CMA data; and MSME support.

## Main services
- [Income Tax Return Filing](https://thewealthbridge.in/income-tax-return-filing/): ITR preparation and filing for individuals, professionals, businesses, firms, companies and trusts.
- [GST Return Filing](https://thewealthbridge.in/gst-return-filing/): GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9 and GSTR-9C with monthly GSTR-2B reconciliation.
- [Income Tax Notices, Hearings & Appeals](https://thewealthbridge.in/income-tax-notices-appeals/): Replies to intimations, scrutiny and reassessment notices, and appeals before CIT(A) and ITAT.
- [GST Notices, Hearings & Appeals](https://thewealthbridge.in/gst-notices-appeals/): ASMT-10, DRC-01A, show cause notices, audit, investigation support and appeals.
- [Companies Act Compliance, Notices & Hearings](https://thewealthbridge.in/companies-act-roc-compliance/): ROC annual filings, event-based filings, ROC notices, adjudication and compounding support.
- [PF & ESI Compliance, Inspections & Hearings](https://thewealthbridge.in/pf-esi-compliance/): PF and ESI registration, monthly returns, inspections, 7A inquiries and ESI assessments.
- [Central & Tamil Nadu Government Subsidies](https://thewealthbridge.in/government-subsidies/): Identifying eligible central and state schemes, applications and follow-up to sanction.
- [Detailed Project Reports & CMA Data](https://thewealthbridge.in/project-report-dpr/): Bank-ready DPRs and CMA data for term loans, working capital, subsidies and investors.
- [MSME Support Services](https://thewealthbridge.in/msme-support/): Udyam, bank finance, CGTMSE, delayed payment recovery and MSME compliance on one desk.

## Other services
- [TDS & TCS Compliance](https://thewealthbridge.in/tds-tcs-compliance/): Deduction advice, quarterly returns, Form 16/16A and TRACES default resolution.
- [Business Registration](https://thewealthbridge.in/business-registration/): Company, LLP, OPC, partnership, proprietorship, GST, FSSAI, IEC and trademark support.
- [Accounting, Bookkeeping & Payroll](https://thewealthbridge.in/accounting-bookkeeping/): Accurate books, reconciliations, MIS and payroll that support tax and finance.
- [Trusts, Societies & Cooperatives](https://thewealthbridge.in/trusts-societies-cooperatives/): Formation, registration, income tax registration and annual compliance.

## Professional disclosure
Wealth Bridge is an independent tax and business consulting firm. Services reserved by law for specified licensed or regulated professionals are not undertaken by the firm; where needed they are performed by independent licensed professionals. Representation before authorities is only in the capacity permitted to an authorised representative under the applicable law.
